description: We are engineering students passionate about AI, software development, and space exploration. Our goal is to build an innovative solution using NASA's open data for the Space Apps Challenge 2026. We welcome developers, AI/ML enthusiasts, UI/UX designers, and space science lovers who enjoy teamwork, creative problem-solving, and building impactful technology. Let's collaborate and aim for global recognition!
summary: ORBIT is an interactive junior astronaut training and space exploration game designed to make space education fun and engaging for young learners. Players take on the identity of Cadet Nova and complete exciting space missions, starting with lunar landing challenges. Through interactive gameplay, mission-based learning, and astronaut training activities, users explore space concepts while developing problem-solving and exploration skills. ORBIT aims to inspire the next generation of space explorers by turning learning into an exciting journey beyond Earth.
details:
ORBIT – Junior Astronaut Academy is an interactive space exploration and astronaut training game designed to make learning about space exciting and accessible for young learners.

Players take on the role of Cadet Nova and embark on missions that simulate astronaut training and space exploration. The experience begins with a lunar landing mission, where players learn about navigation, space environments and astronaut activities. The platform also includes a flight manual and mission-based learning experience.

ORBIT aims to develop curiosity about space science, improve problem-solving skills and inspire children to explore STEM education. Its creative approach combines gaming, storytelling and educational content to transform traditional learning into an engaging space adventure.

The project is designed with an interactive web-based interface, space-themed visuals, mission cards and a gamified experience. It aims to encourage the next generation to discover space and develop an interest in scientific exploration.
